Build's clean: exit 0, 0 errors. The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) from the bumped packages — expected, not bugs.

Both real bugs are fixed:
1. `src/core/options.js` — was reading `options.retries` (old shape), now reads `options.retryCount` (new shape) → link stage no longer crashes on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict boolean check threw on `undefined`; new loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false` → simplified to `flags.backoffEnabled === true`.

Next: run your actual test suite if you have one, to confirm nothing else depended on the old `retries`/strict-boolean behavior.
